definition: corn heated until it bursts into white pieces
description: A girl films herself going to the pictures. First, hands at the desk tear her printed ticket in half and give her back the stub. Then she walks along a dark carpeted passage with numbered doors opening off it, hers the one marked 2, carrying a big striped tub of popcorn in one arm with the ticket stub held between her teeth, and pushes through the black curtain at the end. Inside the auditorium she drops into a seat in the middle of the rows in front of the huge blank white screen, holds up the popcorn and pulls a delighted face at the camera.

de.answer: Sie trägt Popcorn zu ihrem Sitzplatz.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está llevando palomitas a su butaca.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?
